Hybrid Search at Scale: Full-Text + Vectors + Geolocation
Combining BM25, k-NN, and Geo Queries with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
1. Introduction
The Problem: Limitations of Traditional Search
Imagine a business directory search system in Brazil. A user types:
“oficina mecânica especializada em carros importados perto de mim”
A traditional search based solely on full-text search (BM25) would find documents containing exactly those words. But what if the business is registered as:
•
“Centro automotivo - reparos em veículos premium”
•
“Auto service - manutenção BMW, Mercedes, Audi”
Full-text would fail to connect “oficina mecânica” with “centro automotivo”, and “carros importados” with “BMW, Mercedes”. Plus, “perto de mim” wouldn’t even be processed.
The Solution: Multi-Modal Hybrid Search
Hybrid search combines three complementary techniques:
Use Case: Business Search by CNAE
In this article, we’ll build a hybrid search system using public CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) data combined with fictional geolocated businesses.
The index will have:
2. Theoretical Foundations
2.1 Full-Text Search (BM25)
The BM25 (Best Matching 25) algorithm is the standard for text search. It calculates relevance based on:
•
TF (Term Frequency): How many times the term appears in the document
•
IDF (Inverse Document Frequency): How rare the term is in the corpus
•
Document Length Normalization: Shorter documents get a boost
Simplified formula:
score(D, Q) = Σ IDF(qi) × (f(qi, D) × (k1 + 1)) / (f(qi, D) + k1 × (1 - b + b × | D|/avgdl))
Where:
•
k1 = 1.2 (frequency saturation)
•
b = 0.75 (length normalization)
Limitation: BM25 is lexical - it doesn’t understand synonyms or semantic context.
# Example: BM25 doesn't connect these terms query = "carro" doc1 = "automóvel" # ❌ BM25 doesn't find doc2 = "veículo" # ❌ BM25 doesn't find doc3 = "carro" # ✅ Exact match
2.2 Vector Search (k-NN / ANN)
Vector search represents texts as high-dimensional vectors (embeddings) where semantically similar texts are close in vector space.
How it works:
k-NN (k-Nearest Neighbors) algorithm:
•
Given a query vector, finds the k closest vectors
•
Distance measured by cosine (similarity) or Euclidean
ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbors):
•
Exact k-NN is O(n) - too slow for millions of documents
•
HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) offers approximate search in O(log n)
# Embedding with Azure OpenAI from openai import AzureOpenAI import os client = AzureOpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"), api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION", "2025-01-01-preview"), azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"), ) def get_embedding(text: str) -> list[float]: deployment = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_DEPLOYMENT_NAME") response = client.embeddings.create( model=deployment, # Deployment name in Azure input=text ) return response.data[0].embedding # 1536 dimensions
2.3 Geospatial Search
OpenSearch/Elasticsearch support two types of geographic data:
Geospatial queries:
// Distance from a point { "geo_distance": { "distance": "10km", "localizacao": { "lat": -23.55, "lon": -46.63 } } } // Within a bounding box { "geo_bounding_box": { "localizacao": { "top_left": { "lat": -23.4, "lon": -46.8 }, "bottom_right": { "lat": -23.7, "lon": -46.5 } } } }
2.4 Why Combine? (Complementarity)
Each technique has strengths and weaknesses:
The combination is powerful because:
1.
BM25 ensures exact terms have weight (ex: specific CNAE code)
2.
k-NN expands semantically (ex: “mecânica” → “auto service”)
3.
Geo filters by geographic relevance (ex: only in my city)

4. Solution Architecture
4.1 Index Design (Mapping)
Our estabelecimentos_v001 index will combine all three modalities:
PUT /estabelecimentos_v001 { "settings": { "index": { "number_of_shards": 1, "number_of_replicas": 0, "knn": true }, "analysis": { "filter": { "brazilian_stop": { "type": "stop", "stopwords": "_brazilian_" }, "brazilian_stemmer": { "type": "stemmer", "language": "brazilian" } }, "analyzer": { "brazilian_text": { "type": "custom", "tokenizer": "standard", "filter": [ "lowercase", "asciifolding", "brazilian_stop", "brazilian_stemmer" ] } } } }, "mappings": { "properties": { "cnpj": { "type": "keyword" },
"razao_social": { "type": "text", "analyzer": "brazilian_text" }, "cnae_codigo": { "type": "keyword" }, "cnae_descricao": { "type": "text", "analyzer": "brazilian_text" }, "atividade_descritiva": { "type": "text", "analyzer": "brazilian_text" }, "texto_busca": { "type": "text", "analyzer": "brazilian_text" }, "embedding": { "type": "knn_vector", "dimension": 1536, "method": { "name": "hnsw", "space_type": "cosinesimil", "engine": "lucene", "parameters": { "ef_construction": 128, "m": 16 } } }, "localizacao": { "type": "geo_point" }, "endereco": { "type": "object", "properties": { "logradouro": { "type": "text" }, "numero": { "type": "keyword" }, "bairro": { "type": "text" }, "municipio": { "type": "keyword" }, "uf": { "type": "keyword" }, "cep": { "type": "keyword" } } }, "situacao_cadastral": { "type": "keyword" }, "porte": { "type": "keyword" } } } }
4.2 Ingestion Pipeline
4.3 Hybrid Scoring Strategies
There are 3 main approaches to combine scores:
A) Post-fusion (Reciprocal Rank Fusion - RRF)
Executes separate queries and combines rankings:
RRF_score = Σ 1 / (k + rank_i)
B) Score Combination (Weighted Sum)
Normalizes and sums scores with weights:
final_score = w1 × norm(bm25) + w2 × norm(knn) + w3 × norm(geo)
C) OpenSearch Hybrid Query (Recommended)
Native query that performs fusion internally:
{ "query": { "hybrid": { "queries": [ { "match": { "texto_busca": "oficina mecânica" } }, { "knn": { "embedding": { "vector": [...], "k": 10 } } } ] } }, "post_filter": { "geo_distance": { "distance": "10km", "localizacao": {...} } } }
5. Practical Implementation
5.1 Creating the Hybrid Index
from opensearchpy import OpenSearch client = OpenSearch(hosts=["localhost:9200"]) # Create index with k-NN enabled INDEX_SETTINGS = { "settings": { "index": { "knn": True, "knn.algo_param.ef_search": 100 }, "analysis": { "analyzer": { "brazilian_text": { "type": "custom", "tokenizer": "standard", "filter": ["lowercase", "asciifolding", "brazilian_stop", "brazilian_stemmer"] } } } }, "mappings": { "properties": { "texto_busca": {"type": "text", "analyzer": "brazilian_text"}, "embedding": { "type": "knn_vector", "dimension": 1536, "method": { "name": "hnsw", "space_type": "cosinesimil", "engine": "lucene" } }, "localizacao": {"type": "geo_point"} } } } client.indices.create(index="estabelecimentos_v001", body=INDEX_SETTINGS)
5.2 Setting Up Analyzers for Portuguese
The brazilian_text analyzer processes Portuguese text:
{ "analysis": { "filter": { "brazilian_stop": { "type": "stop", "stopwords": "_brazilian_" // Removes: de, da, para, com, etc. }, "brazilian_stemmer": { "type": "stemmer", "language": "brazilian" // carros → carr, mecânica → mecan } }, "analyzer": { "brazilian_text": { "tokenizer": "standard", "filter": [ "lowercase", // OFICINA → oficina "asciifolding", // mecânica → mecanica "brazilian_stop", "brazilian_stemmer" ] } } } }
Analyzer test:
POST /estabelecimentos_v001/_analyze { "analyzer": "brazilian_text", "text": "Oficina Mecânica de Carros Importados" } # Result: ["oficin", "mecan", "carr", "import"]
5.3 Indexing Documents with Embeddings
from openai import AzureOpenAI from opensearchpy import helpers import os # Azure OpenAI configuration azure_client = AzureOpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"), api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"), azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"), ) EMBEDDINGS_DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_DEPLOYMENT_NAME") def get_embedding(text: str) -> list[float]: """Generates embedding with Azure OpenAI.""" response = azure_client.embeddings.create( model=EMBEDDINGS_DEPLOYMENT, input=text ) return response.data[0].embedding def prepare_document(doc: dict) -> dict: """Prepares document for indexing.""" # Concatenate text for search texto = f"{doc['razao_social']}. {doc['cnae_descricao']}. {doc['atividade']}" return { **doc, "texto_busca": texto, "embedding": get_embedding(texto) } # Bulk indexing documents = [prepare_document(d) for d in raw_documents] actions = [ {"_index": "estabelecimentos_v001", "_source": doc} for doc in documents ] helpers.bulk(client, actions)
5.4 Hybrid Queries (3 Approaches)
Approach 1: Full-Text + Geo (No Vectors)
def busca_fulltext_geo(query: str, lat: float, lon: float, raio_km: float): """Textual search filtered by location.""" return client.search( index="estabelecimentos_v001", body={ "query": { "bool": { "must": { "multi_match": { "query": query, "fields": ["razao_social^2", "cnae_descricao", "texto_busca"] } }, "filter": { "geo_distance": { "distance": f"{raio_km}km", "localizacao": {"lat": lat, "lon": lon} } } } }, "sort": [ "_score", {"_geo_distance": {"localizacao": {"lat": lat, "lon": lon}, "order": "asc"}} ] } )
Approach 2: Vector + Geo (No BM25)
def busca_vetorial_geo(query: str, lat: float, lon: float, raio_km: float, k: int = 10): """Semantic search filtered by location.""" query_embedding = get_embedding(query) return client.search( index="estabelecimentos_v001", body={ "query": { "bool": { "must": { "knn": { "embedding": { "vector": query_embedding, "k": k } } }, "filter": { "geo_distance": { "distance": f"{raio_km}km", "localizacao": {"lat": lat, "lon": lon} } } } } )
Approach 3: Complete Hybrid (BM25 + k-NN + Geo)
def busca_hibrida_completa( query: str, lat: float, lon: float, raio_km: float, peso_bm25: float = 0.3, peso_knn: float = 0.7 ): """Combines BM25 and k-NN with script_score.""" query_embedding = get_embedding(query)
return client.search( index="estabelecimentos_v001", body={ "query": { "script_score": { "query": { "bool": { "should": [ {"multi_match": {"query": query, "fields": ["texto_busca"]}} ], "filter": { "geo_distance": { "distance": f"{raio_km}km", "localizacao": {"lat": lat, "lon": lon} } } } }, "script": { "source": f""" double bm25 = _score; double knn = cosineSimilarity(params.vec, 'embedding') + 1.0; return ({peso_bm25} * bm25) + ({peso_knn} * knn); """, "params": {"vec": query_embedding} } } } } )

7. Production and Observability
7.1 Latency Monitoring
# Middleware for query logging import time import structlog logger = structlog.get_logger() async def search_with_metrics(query_body: dict): start = time.perf_counter() response = await client.search( index="estabelecimentos_v001", body=query_body ) latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000 logger.info( "search_executed", latency_ms=latency_ms, total_hits=response["hits"]["total"]["value"], took_ms=response["took"], shards_total=response["_shards"]["total"], shards_successful=response["_shards"]["successful"] ) return response
7.2 Relevance A/B Testing
# Feature flags to test different weights SEARCH_CONFIGS = { "control": {"peso_bm25": 0.5, "peso_knn": 0.5}, "variant_a": {"peso_bm25": 0.3, "peso_knn": 0.7}, "variant_b": {"peso_bm25": 0.2, "peso_knn": 0.8}, } def get_search_config(user_id: str) -> dict: """Determines config based on user_id hash.""" bucket = hash(user_id) % 100 if bucket &lt; 33: return SEARCH_CONFIGS["control"] elif bucket &lt; 66: return SEARCH_CONFIGS["variant_a"] else: return SEARCH_CONFIGS["variant_b"]
7.3 Fallback Strategies
async def search_with_fallback(query: str, lat: float, lon: float): """Search with progressive fallbacks.""" try: # Attempt 1: Full hybrid return await busca_hibrida_completa(query, lat, lon, raio_km=10) except Exception as e: logger.warning("hybrid_search_failed", error=str(e)) try: # Fallback 2: Full-text + geo only return await busca_fulltext_geo(query, lat, lon, raio_km=10) except Exception as e: logger.warning("fulltext_search_failed", error=str(e)) try: # Fallback 3: Full-text only (no geo) return await busca_fulltext(query) except Exception as e: logger.error("all_searches_failed", error=str(e)) raise
